about_the_game:
Prepare to create your own army of the undead! With detailed spritesheets, portraits, and numerous customization options, you can bring your apocalyptic world to (un)life with hordes of terrifying zombies. From the slow-moving shamblers to the fast and deadly runners, these spritesheets will let you create your own unique and disturbing zombies. Use them to populate your wastelands, infest your cities, and terrorize your survivors.

This asset pack contains over 50 pieces for you to create your own apocalyptic zombies!

All zombie pieces come in 8 directional facings with a multitude of supported animations ranging from movement to combat, from standing still to dying, and much more. Each piece contains 440 frames of animation. Also included are 8 large zombie portraits that can be used as paperdolls, busts, face-sets, and more.


Contents:

* 8 directional facings for all pieces
* 440 frames of animation
* Includes large zombie portraits

These character pieces are fully compatible with all other PVGames character pieces with the RPGTools asset label so you are free to mix and match and grow your extensive character piece library!

These tiles are fully compatible with all other PVGames tiles from the RPGTools line of assets.

Terms of Use:

This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.
OK to be used in Commercial projects
Contents can be edited
OK for use in games with gore
OK for use in adult-rated games
